home.intro: I'm learning to program video games in C++, starting from the basics. The goal is long and specific: to work at Rockstar Games one day. This is where I document every step: what I study, what I build, and what I get wrong.

about.title: About
about.bio1: I'm Yuri, based in Ascoli Piceno, Italy. I've built websites and small tools before, but games are what I really care about, and I want to understand how they're made from the inside.
about.job: I work as an ambulance driver and EMT in Italy's 118 emergency service: long shifts, which I now also use to study.
about.bio2: My plan: two years of C++, game math and graphics engines, then a first job in the industry, and later on, Rockstar Games.
about.skillsList: C++ (learning), HTML/CSS/JavaScript, React, PHP, Python (basic), Git, Linux
